description: This file defines the TextFragment class and related iterator class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides functionality for handling text segments, including indexing, comparison, trimming, and iteration over text fragments, likely used for parsing or processing text data within the project.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Represents a segment of text with indexing capabilities, supporting comparison, trimming, and data access functionalities.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing segments within a TextFragment, supporting iteration, current segment access, and remainder retrieval.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Helper class within TextFragment for managing start position and length of a text segment.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the TextFragment to an empty state.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a character at a specific index within the fragment.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality with another TextFragment, TCHAR array, or string.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality with another TextFragment, TCHAR array, or string.

methods.name: OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if the fragment starts with given characters.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the fragment is empty.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the fragment.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the fragment's data.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the fragment as a std::string.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Compares the fragment with another TextFragment or TCHAR array, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a delimiter character or string starting from an offset.

methods.name: ForwardSkip
methods.description: Skips characters until a non-delimiter is found.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a delimiter character or string.
